interpretation: Reported values support B/C as the 12 V-side positive contacts and E/F as its return group, not necessarily protective earth. A/D are additional contacts on the PoE brick. A separate floating A-D output remains possible; fading A/D-to-E/F readings alone do not diagnose failed PoE output, establish an enable pin, or prove compatibility.

next_measurement.followup: Recheck black E/red B for the 12.3 V output, then unplug AC.
next_measurement.limits: No jumper, load, current or further resistance test selected. Direct A-D voltage does not by itself prove load capacity or router compatibility.
